name: Gleaming Crescent Necklace

guaranteedRewards.name: Replica Crescent Necklace
tooltip: "A cheap imitation of a sentimental necklace. With the original returned, this gift has been given meaning of its own."

narrative.details:
<The silver necklace in your hands gleams gently as you examine it. The small crescent moon shape seems similar to other night elf symbols you've seen before.

Upon flipping the necklace over there is a small inscription: "Alor'lormah, Maliynn". Perhaps it belongs to Maliynn in Astranaar?>
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.
